defects.title: EmergencyBanner mobile action clipping + desktop grid
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: Action cluster uses shrink-0 + Button whitespace-nowrap inside a flex-wrap row; on narrow viewports the cluster keeps large min-content width and can be clipped by overflow-x:hidden ancestors. Desktop side-by-side flex is not a stable content|actions grid, so meta text and 5–6 actions compete horizontally.
defects.proposedMinimalCssLayoutChange: Switch EmergencyBanner outer layout to responsive grid (minmax(0,1fr) + auto) or flex-col then row; make action cluster w-full min-w-0 flex-wrap and remove shrink-0. No handler/behaviour changes.

defects.title: Topbar mobile brand overlap
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: Mobile ribbon packs hamburger + non-shrinking brand-compact (full title + subtitle) + clinic-select-compact (max-width 160px) against shrink-0 ribbon-right controls, causing overlap under ~390–430px.
defects.proposedMinimalCssLayoutChange: At mobile breakpoints hide brand subtitle and truncate/clamp brand strong, or show brand-dot only while hamburger is visible; optionally tighten clinic-select max-width. No clinic/search/online handler changes.

defects.title: Page H1 truncation
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: H1 carries Tailwind truncate (nowrap + ellipsis). Module titles ellipsize whenever the header row is width-constrained beside the inbox affordance.
defects.proposedMinimalCssLayoutChange: Remove truncate from H1; allow wrap/break-words; keep page-title min-w-0. No module title data changes.

defects.title: Sidebar footer overlap
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: sidebar-user is a single horizontal flex row of avatar + name/role + v27-sidebar-role (margin-left:auto, select max-width 112px) plus demo note; inside 288px the name and act-as controls visually overlap/cramp.
defects.proposedMinimalCssLayoutChange: Restyle sidebar-user to wrapping flex or CSS grid with role control on full-width second row; select max-width 100%; margin-left 0. Keep identity onChange behaviour unchanged.

defects.title: Element-clipping QA gap
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: pageProbe overflowHits only scan button/a/module-section-nav/v32-nav-toggle/main/content via scrollWidth>clientWidth; miss EmergencyBanner actions, brand-compact, PageHeader h1, sidebar-user; no ancestor overflow clipping check; overflowHits are not part of adjudicateFail (only horizontalOverflow fails).
defects.proposedMinimalCssLayoutChange: N/A (validator). Expand chrome selectors; add bounding-box vs overflow-parent clip detection; optionally fail matrix on chrome-scoped element-clip only to avoid .content scrollWidth noise.
defects.protectedScopeRisk: none-for-business-rules; flake risk if ungated .content scrollWidth becomes hard-fail — mitigate with chrome-scoped gating
defects.evidenceNote: prod-matrix-v3 recorded 232 overflowHits dominated by .content/.main scrollWidth — not owner chrome defects D1–D4.

defects.title: Abort allowlist precision (ERR_ABORTED)
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: onRequestFailed allowlists same-origin net::ERR_ABORTED when url has _rsc= OR /_next/ OR resourceType()==='fetch'; the bare fetch disjunct is broader than documented RSC/prefetch intent.
defects.proposedMinimalCssLayoutChange: N/A (validator). Require same-origin + ERR_ABORTED + (_rsc= query OR documented Next prefetch header/signature). Remove unrestricted resourceType()==='fetch'. Update classification-rationale copy.

priorProof6446.verification: All 6446 entries are same-origin fetch net::ERR_ABORTED URLs containing _rsc=; zero fetch aborts lack _rsc=. Narrowing away from arbitrary fetch preserves this proof set.

defects.title: Hydration suppression governance
defects.rootCauseHypothesis: THEME_INIT_SCRIPT mutates html classList theme-dark, data-appearance, and style.colorScheme before hydrate; SSR html is className=h-full only. suppressHydrationWarning on root html is the correct React escape hatch and must not be added on content nodes.
defects.proposedMinimalCssLayoutChange: No runtime change. Keep suppressHydrationWarning on root html only. Document theme-init vs suppression complementarity; assess removal as requiring cookie/SSR theme (out of batch). Optional test: single-site assertion.
defects.removability: not-recommended-without-server-known-preference; removing suppression while keeping theme-init reintroduces html attribute hydration warnings

outOfScope: new suppressHydrationWarning sites outside root html
